The '''Vycinyth system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]] of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vycinyth]]. It was in [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector's]] [[Barnaba Province]], near [[Crella system/Legends|Crella]].
